acceptance_criteria.statement: When two supported writers overlap, one completes its persisted mutation before the other changes Saga state; a writer that cannot proceed within the configured timeout returns a busy error.
A relative content edit whose expected digest differs from current content is rejected without applying its delta; the author must reread the current value.

content.overview:
Independent records can be authored separately. Cooperative locks serialize supported writers; relative diagram edits require the content digest the author read. Complete content replacements edit current values, and Git handles branch history and merge conflicts.

Each current record is published atomically. Multi-file normalization preserves legacy sources until converted references and current publications succeed, then removes obsolete metadata. This is not a global crash-atomic transaction. A retry completes interrupted normalization without inventing another history store.
content.statement: As a developer collaborating in parallel, I can submit a Saga mutation without overwriting another writer's newer work so concurrent edits remain recoverable.
content.title: Author safely alongside concurrent writers
